messages:
fiona: heads-up — our sampleapp kept authenticating with the old project key after ops injected an org key via sidecar. streams stayed on old principal. anyone seen env rotation get ignored?
raj: which sdk/version? sounds like a cache-vs-env precedence issue.
fiona: go-sdk v1.3.0. container had ~/.redwood/credentials created at init. sidecar later set REDWOOD_API_KEY_ORG. requests still used project key.
claire: yep — older sdks prefer the on-disk credentials file. processes don't re-evaluate env at runtime, so injected env changes don't flip auth unless you restart or remove the cache.
raj: short-term fix: remove ~/.redwood/credentials in the startup script when REDWOOD_API_KEY_* present. long-term: sdk should warn if env and cache disagree and document rotation behavior.
ops-bot: Created issue DEVEX-5012: "SDK credential precedence during env rotation — add warning + docs". linked redwood/sdk and sampleapp repos.
fiona: assigning @claire to draft the warning text and @raj to add the init cleanup to sampleapp. i'll update onboarding quickstart about baked creds in containers. thanks!
